# Studio Form

Studio Form is a leading global developer of custom enterprise agentic AI platforms, headquartered in Indore, India. We build and deploy production-ready autonomous systems, multilingual voice agents, private domain-specific Large Language Models (LLMs), and layout-aware document intelligence architectures for enterprises globally.

## Core Offerings

### 1. Autonomous AI Voice Agents
Conversational AI telephony systems for enterprise customer service, lead qualification, and transaction verification.
- **Dialect Support:** High accuracy in English, Hindi, and regional Indic dialects like Marathi, Bengali, Tamil, and Bhojpuri.
- **Telephony Integration:** Inbound reception, outbound qualifier campaigns, and CRM integrations.

### 2. Custom LLM Development & Fine-Tuning
Secure, private hosting and fine-tuning of domain-specific language models (e.g., Claude, Llama 3, GPT-4, Gemini) on isolated enterprise cloud instances.
- **Compliance:** 100% data privacy aligned with regional residency requirements and India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act of 2023.

### 3. Enterprise RAG & Document Intelligence
Layout-aware RAG search engines parsing complex tables, charts, and unstructured documents (PDFs, reports) with zero hallucinations.
- **Infrastructure:** Built using advanced vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, MongoDB Atlas) and custom reranking models.

### 4. AI Workshops & Consulting
Custom prompts engineering bootcamps, executive C-suite strategy seminars, model evaluation frameworks, and deployment governance advisory.
